shots.action_description: The roaster wipes sweat from their forehead with the back of their hand as they inspect a batch of freshly roasted beans.
shots.visual_prompt: Early morning natural sidelight from one window, warm practical bulbs, soft contrast, no hard rim light. The roaster is in front of the drum roaster, wearing a rolled-up chambray shirt and waxed canvas apron with a brass pin.
shots.voiceover_line: We source our green coffee from two importers who publish their farm partners.

shots.action_description: The regular walks into the roastery, cycling cap and olive rain jacket, carrying a dented enamel travel mug.
shots.visual_prompt: Soft contrast, warm practical bulbs. The regular is walking towards the counter, with the burlap coffee sacks stacked on a pallet in the background.

shots.action_description: The roaster stands behind the counter in the new shop, wearing a reclaimed oak apron with a hand-lettered sign reading 'Now Open'.
shots.visual_prompt: Reclaimed oak counter, two-group espresso machine. The roaster is standing behind the counter, with the street visible outside through the window.
shots.voiceover_line: Stop in at our second shop this week.
